rule_summary: Québec residents must be covered by prescription drug insurance for the whole year, either through a private/group plan or the RAMQ public plan. On the income tax return (Schedule K), a premium is calculated for any month the person was registered with the RAMQ public plan and not otherwise covered by a group plan. Having a job does not by itself prove group prescription drug coverage — the employer/internship plan must actually include basic prescription drug insurance. Coverage status can differ month by month.
uncertainty_notes: Whether an internship/employment plan included BASIC PRESCRIPTION DRUG coverage must be confirmed from plan documents, not inferred from employment.
Thresholds and the Schedule K premium formula change each tax year — verify against the current-year guide.
